notes: The prebuilt Chromium Orbit Browser repacks: ungoogled-chromium, whose builds already have Google's web services, sign-in and reporting removed. Each platform pins the download URL and its SHA-256, the way the former firefox.json did. These are empty here and populated by `python3 scripts/update_chromium.py`, which reads the latest ungoogled-chromium release and its checksums; scripts/build.py refuses a build whose checksum is empty or does not match. ungoogled-chromium ships per-architecture macOS builds (no universal), so mac-x64 and mac-arm64 are separate.
